title: Pulse migration plan
description: A plan to migrate the instances of one BPMN process from one version to another, named by the process id and the two version numbers. pulse plan-migration writes it, and Pulse for VS Code edits it in diagrams, checked on the engine you pick. It names no engine and no instance, and opening it migrates nothing.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the plan format; without it a file reads as version 1.

bpmnProcessId.description: The id of the process in the BPMN model.

mappings.description: Each element of the source version that maps onto an element of the target version.

side.description: A version of the process, by its number on an engine.

elementId.description: A BPMN element id, or an element id with one # part for its scope.
